name: Hasadja
title: Descendant of King David
summary: Hasadja was a descendant of King David through the lineage of Zerubbabel, mentioned in 1 Chronicles. He belonged to the royal line that continued through the exile in Babylon. His name means 'the Lord is gracious,' reflecting hope in God's faithfulness toward David's offspring.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in David's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Hasadja is listed as one of Zerubbabel's sons in the genealogical record of David's royal lineage in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Royal Lineage After the Exile
keyEvents.description: Hasadja belonged to the generation of David's descendants who lived during and after the Babylonian exile, representing continuity in the messianic line.

keyEvents.title: Zerubbabel's Family
keyEvents.description: As a son of Zerubbabel, who led the Jews back from Babylon and rebuilt the temple, Hasadja was part of an important family in Israel's history after the exile.

keyEvents.title: David's Lineage Preserved Through the Exile
keyEvents.description: The genealogy in 1 Chronicles shows that God's promise to David of an eternal throne was kept alive through descendants like Hasadja, even amidst the trials of exile.
